title: GM Cockpit, Instant Prep, Scene Recipes & Preview-as-Player
objective: Deliver the low-friction GM preparation cockpit and preview-as-player workflow—drag/drop or import through recognize, calibrate/confirm and Make Playable; semantic placement and scene/audio controls; entitlement-aware provider resolution; and shareable Scene Recipes containing semantic preparation, mappings, provider references and fallback intent without redistributing third-party commercial media—while preserving canonical Scene/owner state, MAI/AAI authority, permissions and completed ISE-01..06 boundaries.
preserved_boundaries: Preview-as-Player consumed only actual authorization-filtered projection; hidden/GM-only inventory, notes, unrevealed regions, protected cardinality and provider secrets were excluded before ISE-07 input.
Smart geometry, room classification, placement, audio-cue and fallback suggestions remained assistance until confirmed where certainty was insufficient.
Make Playable emitted expected-version/idempotent existing owner-operation proposals and performed no canonical Scene or owner mutation.
Scene Audio Deck consumed AAI capability/entitlement evidence as evidence only; ISE-07 inferred no rights, called no providers, stored no credentials and acquired no content bytes.
Scene Recipes remained reference-only semantic preparation metadata and contained no commercial third-party media bytes, credential material, hidden state or ISE-07 entitlement claims.
No parallel preparation, Scene, asset, permission or provider ledger was created.
Missing assets, placeholders, silence and mapless theater-of-the-mind remained valid nonblocking states.
Migration 0022 was not reserved and ISE-08 implementation authority was not created.
Paid provider activation, tester distribution, release and deployment were not authorized.

changed_since_previous: Changed only the final focused regression's theater-of-the-mind and silence assertions from singular getByText queries to getAllByText count assertions because the composed Scene intentionally exposes those fallback concepts in multiple inherited/current status surfaces.
No product contract, UI behavior, authority boundary, current-family profile scope, persistence posture or predecessor implementation changed.
